data.title: Betagro names Tre Porapat as first 'Friend of Perfecta', boosting its premium pet food status.
data.description: Bangkok –August 26,2026 – BetagroPublic Company Limited (BTG), a leading integrated food company in Thailand, has announced actor Tre –PorapatSrikajorndechaas the first “Friend of Perfecta”. This partnership underscores Perfecta’s dedication to a new generation of premium pet parents and reinforces its “Caring with Heart” concept, which delivers superior, nutritious,high-qualityand fresh pet food to support theoptimalhealth of beloved companions.

data.title: MDES-depa celebrates success of coding Thailand 2026
data.description: The Ministry of Digital Economy and Society (MDES), through the Digital Economy Promotion Agency (depa), has announced the success of Coding Thailand 2026: AI Inspires the Future, a project aimed at promoting coding and artificial intelligence (AI) skills among Thai students and teachers nationwide. More than 12,000 students and teachers from across the country registered toparticipatein the project. After completing a series of learning activities and knowledge assessments, 3,224 participants from 806 teams were selected to take part in the regional competitions.

data.title: Shield Insurance Broker Wins Best Customer Experience Initiative in Thailand 2026
data.description: Shield Insurance Broker, operated by Ngern Tid Lor Public Company Limited, a subsidiary of Tidlor Holdings (TIDLOR), won the Best Customer Experience Initiative in Thailand under the Retail Finance Digital and Frictionless Awards category at The Asian Banker Thailand Awards 2026 . This reflects its success in transforming its role from an insurance broker into a Service Broker. The focus goes beyond selling policies to prioritizing relationship building and continuous customer care throughout the coverage journey. This ranges from pre-purchase consultation, sales, and 24-hour after-sales care, to claim coordination and status tracking. The service model integrates the Shield Insurance Broker Call Center 1501, where a team of experts is on standby 24/7 for emergency coordination, ensuring our customers truly experience peace of mind from purchase to claim."

data.title: MQDC Launches Mulberry Grove The Forestias, a Super Luxury Multi-Generational Condo
data.description: Magnolia Quality Development Corporation Limited (MQDC) has launched Mulberry Grove The Forestias Condominiums, a super luxury low-rise condominium development spanning over 16 rai within The Forestias. Construction is now complete, and the project is ready for occupancy. The development stands out for its expansive surrounding greenery and design approach that seamlessly integrates nature with urban living, under the concept of Nurturing Multi-Generational Living — creating a residence where every member of the family, across every generation, can live and thrive together.

data.title: TCMA honoured with Climate Partner Award
data.description: Thai Cement Manufacturers Association (TCMA) has been selected to receive the Thai Climate Partnership: DCCE Climate Partner Award from Department of Climate Change and Environment (DCCE). The award was presented by DrRaweewanBhuridej, Permanent Secretary of Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), in recognition of TCMA’s sustained collaboration with government, the private sector and international partners to turn climate ambitions into practical action and support Thailand’s journey towards Net Zero 2050.

data.title: MT4 vs MT5 in 2026: Which platform best fits your trading style?
data.description: When people discuss trading platforms, MT4 and MT5 are often mentioned together, as choosing between them is sometimes viewed as purely a technical decision. In fact, there is no unified approach to working with them, and each trader chooses a platform according to his or her experience, trading strategies and preferences.

data.title: How to Read a Central Bank Statement
data.description: The news feed brings you the headline: "Fed Holds Rates." Only three words that mean absolutely nothing to you. The rates remained the same, but the euro still lost half a per cent in just minutes. Here comes the importance of the difference between decision and reaction. In this article, the reasons for reactions when headlines do not change are provided.

data.title: Huawei Cloud drives ERP modernisation for Advice IT Infinite
data.description: BANGKOK, Aug 19, 2026 – Huawei Cloud announced the successful migration of Advice IT Infinite Public Company Limited’s ERP system to Huawei Cloud, enabling one of Thailand’s leading IT (information technology) retailers and wholesalers to strengthen system reliability, improve operational efficiency and build a scalable digital foundation to support continued business expansion.

data.title: TAT defines The Year of Transformation as Thailand’s 2027 tourism direction
data.description: Bangkok, Aug 24, 2026 – The Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) has unveiled “The Year of Transformation” as Thailand’s strategic tourism direction for 2027, built around four strategic moves supporting “The Winning Goal 2027”. TAT targets tourism revenue growth of at least 5% over 2026, a 60:40 visitor distribution between major and emerging destinations, and a place among Asia’s top three destinations for traveller loyalty, working towards the goal of becoming “Asia’s No.1 High-Value & Meaningful Destination”.

data.title: Generali Thailand and Krungsri Auto Broker Extend Strategic Partnership for Five Years

data.title: Beyond the Magnificent Seven: The Next Wave of AI Investment
data.description: The first phase of the artificial intelligence (AI) investment story belonged to a handful of remarkable companies. Apple, Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Nvidia, Meta and Tesla, the so-called Magnificent Seven, sit at the centre of the most important technology shift in a generation, and the market has rewarded them for it. They now account for roughly a third of the S&P 500, and in 2025 they produced about 42% of the index's total return1. Buy a plain US index fund today and nearly 40 cents of every dollar goes into just 10 companies.
